E4b (payload-45, mixed scope, netem on both ends): fan-out ≈ fit(45) + V·P/rate, with V the bytes a framework moves per VM link and round in units of P: 4 for NVFlare and Flower (2 sites, each P down and P up), 17.8 for vantage6 (2 sites x (4 input copies down + 1 result up) x 1.78 for double base64; vantage6 section §4). Efficiency = plan lower bound 4·P/rate ÷ measured.
